etc.text: Go to the `/etc` directory and list what's in it.
etc.hint: Two commands: first `cd`, then `ls`. You can also write them on the same line: `cd /etc && ls`.

hidden.text: Show the hidden files in your home directory.
hidden.hint: The `-a` option shows files that start with a dot. Your home directory is `~`.

relative.text: Go to the root (`/`), and then go to `/var/log` using a **relative** path.
relative.hint: A relative path doesn't start with `/`. If you're in `/`, `cd var/log` is all you need.

home.text: Go back to your home directory with just `cd`, without any arguments.
